scientific_limitations: Infinite well-mixed population and deterministic continuous-time replicator dynamics only.
Exogenously fixed experienced group-size law supported on two and four individuals.
Two-volunteer threshold, nonrefundable constant cost, and nonrivalrous benefit.
Strict five-equilibrium classification excludes bifurcation equalities.
Not independently validated; inaccessible full text of the earliest fixed-size threshold model leaves historical-priority uncertainty.
title: Four is the sharp group-size threshold for three attracting states in a two-volunteer game
